description: Store prompts as versioned files, not inline magic strings
rationale: Prompts are code and must be reviewed, diffed, and rolled back

description: Omit temperature, top_p, top_k for Claude Opus 4.7+ (non-default values return 400). Use prompting + effort parameter to guide behavior.
rationale: Claude Opus 4.7 rejects non-default sampling params. Temperature=0 never guaranteed determinism anyway.

description: Validate model output against a schema (Zod/Pydantic) before use
rationale: LLMs hallucinate fields; unvalidated output crashes downstream code

description: Retry transient failures with exponential backoff and jitter
rationale: LLM APIs have variable latency and rate limits

description: Track input and output tokens against a budget
rationale: Runaway token usage blows up cost and hits context limits

description: Treat user input as untrusted and sandbox it from system instructions
rationale: Prompt injection can exfiltrate data or subvert guardrails

description: Scrub PII before sending data to third-party LLM providers
rationale: Third-party providers log inputs; PII leakage violates privacy laws

description: Mock the LLM in unit tests; use snapshot tests only with fixed seeds
rationale: Non-deterministic tests are flaky and uninformative

description: Cite retrieved sources in answers and link to the chunk
rationale: Citations enable verification and reduce hallucination trust

description: Never exceed model context window — truncate or summarize first
rationale: Overflow throws API errors and wastes tokens

description: Log and alert on per-request and per-user token cost
rationale: LLM cost spikes can bankrupt products overnight

description: Have a documented fallback model or degraded path
rationale: Provider outages will happen; plan for them

description: Run a golden eval set before shipping prompt changes
rationale: Prompt tweaks cause silent regressions without evals

description: Never send secrets, keys, or credentials into LLM prompts
rationale: Prompt data may be retained and used to train future models
